summary: Tested iOS Safe Area / PWA Navbar fixes and CustomerDashboard booking card layout changes. Both features verified working correctly on desktop.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features verified: (1) LandingNav inline style has 'padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)'. (2) Sticky Navbar (post-login) has 'padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)'. (3) Booking card h4 studio name has class 'break-words leading-snug' (no truncate). (4) Action buttons are inside content div (flex-wrap row). (5) Past booking shows 'JohanINK Est. 2023' fully visible with line-through strikethrough for cancelled status. (6) Booking card layout: date column left, content div right with name+badge, time, type, and actions all stacked vertically. No JSX rendering errors.
